summary: Implemented the direct serialized-model R8 acquisition adapter and wired the existing 96-config runner to it. The execution path verifies the accepted R6/R7 evidence and all 48 ACTUAL_BINARY4_MONO/EDOF source hashes before opening ZOS, consumes those immutable R5.2 models by copy-on-write, changes only the requested physical STOP on the working copy, measures one direct-MONO EFFL scale for each of 48 matched pairs, applies the frozen TASK-009 MTFA Grid=1 acquisition contract across 15 focus planes for 96 configs, validates existing footprint/entity/result invariants, writes exact 96/1440/48 aggregate outputs, and only then permits formal R8 local evidence with manual Web review still required. The legacy carrier+residual preparation path is not used and the previous DIRECT_R5_2_SERIALIZED_MODEL_PAIR_SCALE_BACKEND implementation gap is removed.
limitations: ChatGPT Web did not run OpticStudio, change license settings, or create any R8 runtime optical evidence; formal R8 production results remain pending local execution and subsequent Web review.

Repository-local pytest, Ruff, compileall, and uv lock --check could not be completed in this Web environment because the private repository could not be cloned or resolved from the execution container; direct pytest/compileall targets therefore were not present locally. Ruff was also unavailable and uvx --offline could not resolve it from cache. No GitHub Actions workflow run was present to substitute for those checks.

The adapter has pure unit coverage committed for direct source mapping, 3/5-mm physical STOP semantics, 48-pair grouping, one-MONO-scale pair references, exact 96/1440/48 output schemas, and fail-closed missing/hash-drift behavior, but a live OpticStudio regression is intentionally outside this Web task.
